slides.title: prompts to run a faceless page with an AI agent
slides.sub: Pick a niche, build the system, let the agent run it.
slides.voiceover: Here are seven prompts to build a faceless page that runs on one AI agent.

slides.name: The Niche Picker
slides.sub: Find a niche that pays before you post once.
slides.prompt: Act as a strategist who has grown faceless pages. Give me 5 faceless page niches for [PLATFORM] that could realistically reach [$3,000] a month. For each: the audience, 3 ways it makes money, how crowded it is, and **ONE PROOF** that people already pay in that niche.

lines: Monetizes via: affiliates, sponsors, a guide

slides.voiceover: One. Get five niches that could realistically pay, with proof people already spend there.

slides.name: The Content Engine
slides.sub: 30 days of posts from one brainstorm.
slides.prompt: Be my content director for a faceless [NICHE] page. Build a 30-day plan as a table: 3 content pillars, the format for each day (carousel, Reel, story), a hook for every post, and which posts should send people to my [PRODUCT OR LINK].
slides.tip: Feed it your best-performing post once you have data, so month two builds on what actually works.
slides.voiceover: Two. Turn one brainstorm into a full month of posts, pillars and hooks.

slides.name: The Agent Blueprint
slides.sub: What an AI agent can do for you every day.
slides.prompt: Act as an automation architect. Design an AI agent workflow for my [NICHE] page using [n8n / Make / Zapier]: it finds trending topics, drafts captions in my voice, builds a posting schedule and sends me everything to **APPROVE**. List each step, the tool for it, and what I still do by hand.
slides.voiceover: Three. Design the agent workflow that drafts your content and waits for your approval.

slides.name: The Hook Factory
slides.sub: Stop the scroll in the first line.
slides.prompt: Write 20 scroll-stopping hooks about [TOPIC] for [AUDIENCE]. Use 5 styles: a bold claim, a question, a number, a mistake, a before/after. Keep each under 12 words, nothing I can't back up, and mark the **3 TO TEST FIRST** with the reason.
slides.tip: Post the 3 marked hooks first and let real engagement decide the rest of the batch.
slides.voiceover: Four. Get twenty hooks in five proven styles, with the three to test first.

slides.name: The Money Map
slides.sub: Every income stream, in the right order.
slides.prompt: Act as a creator monetization coach. My faceless page has [FOLLOWERS] followers in [NICHE]. Map every realistic income stream (affiliates, sponsors, a digital product, UGC): what each needs, what it typically pays, and the **ORDER** to launch them to reach [$3,000] a month.

lines: 2. Digital product - needs a proven hook

slides.voiceover: Five. Map every income stream and the order to launch them in.

slides.name: The Sponsor Pitch
slides.prompt: Write a short sponsorship pitch to [BRAND] from my [NICHE] page with [FOLLOWERS] followers and [ENGAGEMENT RATE]% engagement. Include a one-line opener, why my audience fits their product, 3 package options with prices, and a polite follow-up for 5 days later.
slides.tip: Send it from an email that matches your page name — it reads far more professional than a personal address.
slides.voiceover: Six. Turn your follower count into a real sponsorship pitch with pricing.

slides.name: The Growth Auditor
slides.sub: Find out why a post flopped.
slides.prompt: Act as a growth analyst. Here are my last 10 posts with reach, saves and shares: [PASTE STATS]. Tell me what the top 3 have in common, what the weakest 3 did wrong, 3 experiments for next week, and a **REALISTIC** follower range for the next 30 days.

lines: Top posts: all used a number hook
Weak posts: no clear first line

slides.voiceover: Seven. Feed it your own stats and get exactly what to change next.

slides.title: Get more out of this pack
items: Run one prompt at a time
Keep the niche pick, content plan and agent blueprint in the same chat so each step builds on the last.
Start the agent as a checklist
Before wiring up n8n or Zapier, run the workflow by hand for a week so you know what to automate first.
The agent drafts, you approve — never let it publish without a human reading it first.
slides.voiceover: Run these in one chat, start the agent as a checklist, and always approve before it posts.
